verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say role changes and departures automatically update access, permissions, and groups. Hiring and offboarding flows trigger device ordering and retrieval, and rules-driven, cross-system workflow automation is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a no-code workflow builder for lifecycle events, detail on per-app provisioning choreography on hire, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, identity events trigger automation — no-code workflows on hire, role change, and departure handle the app-by-app choreography for me

citations.quote: When roles changes or someone leaves, Rippling automatically updates access, permissions, and groups.
automatically provisions or revokes access based on role changes, risk signals, and company policy
Order and reorder new devices or reassign existing ones directly from the hiring flow based on pre-set, role-based device configurations.
The instant an employee is offboarded in Rippling, AI triggers the retrieval flow
You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest.
